description: twitter: User Tweets. GET /v1/twitter/user-tweets. Get up to 100 popular tweets from a user's public profile, not their latest tweets. Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Costs 0 credits when tweets is empty. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.
